research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Neural Magic is researching systems and methods for improved neural network execution, focusing on neural network processing using structured sparse data and processing that reduces instruction usage. They develop techniques for determining and executing deep tensor columns entirely within cache and for parallelizing sub computations across neural network layers to increase efficiency. Their work centers on sparse weight matrices, cache aware execution, and optimized instruction level operations.

product.name: Neural Magic Compress
product.description: A subscription service providing enterprise-grade tools and support for compressing and optimizing large language models for efficient inference.

product.name: nm-vllm
product.description: An enterprise inference server for deploying open-source large language models on GPUs with optimizations for sparsity and quantization.

product.name: DeepSparse
product.description: A sparsity-aware inference runtime that accelerates large language models, computer vision, and NLP models on commodity CPUs.

product.name: SparseML
product.description: A toolkit for compressing machine learning models using sparsity and quantization to optimize inference performance.

product.name: Neural Magic Model Repository
product.description: A collection of pre-optimized, open-source large language models compressed for efficient and faster inference.
